Sighting(s) Notes: Saw the doe first, then the bucks followed
Came and left from the creek. Ranged her at 25yds. Got her in my cross hairs and watched her eat for 10 minutes. Too small.

First buck was behind my right shoulder, hugging Finches property line. Never stopped walking towards the swamp.
17:23-17:49 - The second buck was sizeable. Also came from the left behind me. I heard him rubbing a tree (then saw the tree shaking) well before I saw him. Heard him vocalizing for a long time. Saw him for a while but never got a shot. Est. 8pt...tall and wide but thin.
18:30 - Saw a doe, perhaps what the buck was vocalizing to?
18:45 - walked up on the buck in the shit stand field, 5+ minute staring contest, he walked right towards me, eventually spooked. When I walked into the field, there was a big doe in the corner still.  Eventually spooked her too.
He came from direction of the lower field, never stopped, and just walked along the edge and ducked back in the woods behind the stand. Looked like 6pt but tall and wide.
He came from behind my left shoulder and walked 15yards away from me. Got him in my cross hairs for practice, but passes with the hopes that something bigger would come along.
She came from the trail leading to the swamp. She was little and I hoped she'd bring in a buck. She kept looking back down the trail but nothing ever followed. She stayed in the field a long time.

Harvest Notes:: Walking up hill towards Finch's, not interested in the field...
